text.WEB: I will meet them like a bear that is bereaved of her cubs, and will tear the covering of their heart. There I will devour them like a lioness. The wild animal will tear them.

text.KJV: O Israel, thou hast destroyed thyself; but in me is thine help.
text.ASV: It is thy destruction, O Israel, that `thou art' against me, against thy help.
text.WEB: You are destroyed, Israel, because you are against me, against your help.

text.KJV: I will be thy king: where is any other that may save thee in all thy cities? and thy judges of whom thou saidst, Give me a king and princes?
text.ASV: Where now is thy king, that he may save thee in all thy cities? and thy judges, of whom thou saidst, Give me a king and princes?
text.WEB: Where is your king now, that he may save you in all your cities? And your judges, of whom you said, ‘Give me a king and princes?’

text.KJV: I gave thee a king in mine anger, and took him away in my wrath.
text.ASV: I have given thee a king in mine anger, and have taken him away in my wrath.
text.WEB: I have given you a king in my anger, and have taken him away in my wrath.

text.KJV: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is hid.
text.ASV: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is laid up in store.
text.WEB: The guilt of Ephraim is stored up. His sin is stored up.

text.KJV: The sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him: he is an unwise son; for he should not stay long in the place of the breaking forth of children.
text.ASV: The sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him: he is an unwise son; for it is time he should not tarry in the place of the breaking forth of children.
text.WEB: The sorrows of a travailing woman will come on him. He is an unwise son; for when it is time, he doesn’t come to the opening of the womb.

text.KJV: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be thy plagues; O grave, I will be thy destruction: repentance shall be hid from mine eyes.
text.ASV: I will ransom them from the power of Sheol; I will redeem them from death: O death, where are thy plagues? O Sheol, where is thy destruction? repentance shall be hid from mine eyes.
text.WEB: I will ransom them from the power of Sheol. I will redeem them from death! Death, where are your plagues? Sheol, where is your destruction? “Compassion will be hidden from my eyes.

text.KJV: Though he be fruitful among his brethren, an east wind shall come, the wind of the LORD shall come up from the wilderness, and his spring shall become dry, and his fountain shall be dried up: he shall spoil the treasure of all pleasant vessels.
text.ASV: Though he be fruitful among his brethren, an east wind shall come, the breath of Jehovah coming up from the wilderness; and his spring shall become dry, and his fountain shall be dried up: he shall make spoil of the treasure of all goodly vessels.
text.WEB: Though he is fruitful among his brothers, an east wind will come, the breath of Yahweh coming up from the wilderness; and his spring will become dry, and his fountain will be dried up. He will plunder the storehouse of treasure.

text.KJV: Samaria shall become desolate; for she hath rebelled against her God: they shall fall by the sword: their infants shall be dashed in pieces, and their women with child shall be ripped up.
text.ASV: Samaria shall bear her guilt; for she hath rebelled against her God: they shall fall by the sword; their infants shall be dashed in pieces, and their women with child shall be ripped up.
text.WEB: Samaria will bear her guilt; for she has rebelled against her God. They will fall by the sword. Their infants will be dashed in pieces, and their pregnant women will be ripped open.”

text.KJV: O israel, return unto the LORD thy God; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity.
text.ASV: O Israel, return unto Jehovah thy God; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity.
text.WEB: Israel, return to Yahweh your God; for you have fallen because of your sin.

text.KJV: Take with you words, and turn to the LORD: say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and receive us graciously: so will we render the calves of our lips.
text.ASV: Take with you words, and return unto Jehovah: say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and accept that which is good: so will we render `as' bullocks `the offering of' our lips.
text.WEB: Take words with you, and return to Yahweh. Tell him, “Forgive all our sins, and accept that which is good: so we offer our lips like bulls.

text.KJV: Asshur shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses: neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, Ye are our gods: for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy.
text.ASV: Assyria shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses; neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, `Ye are' our gods; for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy.
text.WEB: Assyria can’t save us. We won’t ride on horses; neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, ‘Our gods!’ for in you the fatherless finds mercy.”

text.KJV: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely: for mine anger is turned away from him.
text.ASV: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely; for mine anger is turned away from him.
text.WEB: “I will heal their waywardness. I will love them freely; for my anger is turned away from him.

text.KJV: I will be as the dew unto Israel: he shall grow as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.
text.ASV: I will be as the dew unto Israel; he shall blossom as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.
text.WEB: I will be like the dew to Israel. He will blossom like the lily, and send down his roots like Lebanon.

text.KJV: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive tree, and his smell as Lebanon.
text.ASV: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive-tree, and his smell as Lebanon.
text.WEB: His branches will spread, and his beauty will be like the olive tree, and his fragrance like Lebanon.

text.KJV: They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive as the corn, and grow as the vine: the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.
text.ASV: They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive `as' the grain, and blossom as the vine: the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.
text.WEB: Men will dwell in his shade. They will revive like the grain, and blossom like the vine. Their fragrance will be like the wine of Lebanon.

text.KJV: Ephraim shall say, What have I to do any more with idols? I have heard him, and observed him: I am like a green fir tree. From me is thy fruit found.
text.ASV: Ephraim `shall say', What have I to do any more with idols? I have answered, and will regard him: I am like a green fir-tree; from me is thy fruit found.
text.WEB: Ephraim, what have I to do any more with idols? I answer, and will take care of him. I am like a green cypress tree; from me your fruit is found.”

text.KJV: Who is wise, and he shall understand these things? prudent, and he shall know them? for the ways of the LORD are right, and the just shall walk in them: but the transgressors shall fall therein.
text.ASV: Who is wise, that he may understand these things? prudent, that he may know them? for the ways of Jehovah are right, and the just shall walk in them; but transgressors shall fall therein.
text.WEB: Who is wise, that he may understand these things? Who is prudent, that he may know them? For the ways of Yahweh are right, and the righteous walk in them; But the rebellious stumble in them.
